description: This file defines UI component classes for user management menus in the Mattermost system console, including column toggle, filter popover, role/status filter menus, and date range menu, utilizing Playwright for testing interactions.

classes.name: ColumnToggleMenu
classes.description: Represents a toggle menu for columns in the user management UI, allowing visibility checks, item retrieval, toggling, and closing.

classes.name: FilterPopover
classes.description: Represents a filter popover UI component for filtering users by team, role, and status, with methods to interact with dropdowns and apply filters.

classes.name: FilterMenu
classes.description: A generic dropdown menu component for role/status filtering, supporting visibility checks, item selection, and closing.

classes.name: DateRangeMenu
classes.description: A menu component for selecting date ranges, with methods to interact with menu items and close the menu.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the UI component is visible.

methods.name: getMenuItem
methods.description: Retrieves a menu item element by its text label.

methods.name: getAllMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves all menu items within the toggle menu.

methods.name: clickMenuItem
methods.description: Simulates clicking a specified menu item.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Applies filter settings and waits for the popover to close.

methods.name: searchInTeamMenu
methods.description: Performs a search within the team filter dropdown.

methods.name: filterByTeam
methods.description: Selects a team filter option, either by opening dropdown or searching.

methods.name: openRoleMenu
methods.description: Opens the role filter dropdown menu.

methods.name: openStatusMenu
methods.description: Opens the status filter dropdown menu.
